Name: Ellie's Ideal Greenhouse
Author: ellibear
TagLine: Expands the greenhouse. Includes 2 options to choose from depending on your playstyle.
Description:
**_Features_**:
This is a greenhouse expansion mod with 2 versions for you to enjoy depending on your playstyle.
* _Modest_: Can fit 4 Iridium Sprinklers with pressure nozzles for a total of 192 farmable tiles. Also has room for 8 trees along the sides.
* _Expanded_: Comes with 3 separate farming areas. The first two can fit 8 Iridium Sprinklers with pressure nozzles for a total of 384 farmable tiles while the last section has 4 rows of 24 farmable tiles which are great for Hops or other trellised crops (recommend the line sprinklers mod for these). Also has room for 8 trees along the sides.
This is my very first mod - if you notice any issues please leave a comment and I'll try to get it sorted out ASAP.

**_How to Install_**:
1. Install the latest version of [SMAPI](https://smapi.io/).
2. Install the latest version of [Content Patcher](https://www.moddrop.com/stardew-valley/mods/470174-content-patcher).
3. Unzip/extract the **﻿[CP] Ellie's Ideal Greenhouse** folder into your **Stardew Valley\Mods** folder.
4. Run the game once with SMAPI to generate a **config.json** file.
5. Open the **config.json** file using a program such as Notepad (I adore Notepad++). Take a look at the "references" folder to pick the layout you want (either Modest or Expanded).
6. Run the game using SMAPI and enjoy your new greenhouse!
**_Compatibility_**:
This mod alters the "greenhouse.tmx" file so it is not compatible with any mods that also change that file.
**If you are using IF2R from SVE you will need to set the "Disable_IF2R_Greenhouse" config option to false (default is true).
**If you are using Grandpa's Farm from SVE you will need to set the "LargerGreenhouse" config option to false (default is false).

**WARNING!!!**
This mod is best used with an empty greenhouse. If you currently have crops planted in your greenhouse I would recommend clearing it out before adding this mod to your game or else you risk losing crops/gold (they will be shifted and depending on where they were might not be accessible anymore).
